pattern: associate multiple issues without closing them
experience: Branch associations must accept several links without turning them into automatic issue-closing PR keywords.
rule: t3_branch_issues_update stores GitHub branch links without closing issues.
prompt: Associate https://github.com/acme/app/issues/12 and https://github.com/acme/app/issues/34 with branch feature/search in /home/user/acme/app using T3's branch issue tools. Do not change a PR or close either issue.
